phrases.title: Salute
phrases.story: Gather the light, reach overhead, then greet both sides.

phrases.title: Ripple
phrases.story: Catch a drop in each palm and send a ripple outward.

phrases.title: Harvest
phrases.story: Reach, pick, cradle the harvest, and offer it forward.

phrases.title: Flicker
phrases.story: Answer tiny lights with alternating bright hand accents.

phrases.title: Bloom
phrases.story: A closed bud opens, rocks in the breeze, and closes softly.

phrases.title: Honey Step
phrases.story: Tap each side, stack the rhythm, and share the honey.

phrases.title: Raindance
phrases.story: Make a canopy, brush away the rain, and open to the sky.

phrases.title: Shell Sway
phrases.story: Listen to one shell, then the other, with a gentle sway.

phrases.title: Kite Flight
phrases.story: Guide a kite up, across the wind, and safely home.

phrases.title: New Growth
phrases.story: Rise from a seed, stretch new leaves, and settle.

phrases.title: Lantern Lift
phrases.story: Lift a lantern and carry its glow from side to side.

phrases.title: Rainbow Arc
phrases.story: Paint a broad arc overhead and open the colors.

phrases.title: Skipping Stone
phrases.story: Wind up and skim a stone from each side.

phrases.title: Crystal Waltz
phrases.story: Open, close, and turn like a drifting snowflake.

phrases.title: Feather Float
phrases.story: Float each arm on the breeze before a soft landing.

phrases.title: Waterlily
phrases.story: Unfurl across the water with slow mirrored reaches.

phrases.title: Star Wish
phrases.story: Hold a wish, find two stars, and release it upward.

phrases.title: Fireside Clap
phrases.story: Warm the hands, clap, and welcome both sides.

phrases.title: Breeze Turn
phrases.story: Trade broad arm sails while making a bounded pivot.

phrases.title: Moon Lullaby
phrases.story: Cradle and sway before lifting a quiet moon.

phrases.title: Facet Lock
phrases.story: Present alternating facets and lock a bright diamond.

phrases.title: Eclipse
phrases.story: Cover, cross, and uncover the light in a measured orbit.

phrases.title: Comet Trail
phrases.story: Wind up, launch across the body, and follow each trail.

phrases.title: Circuit Trace
phrases.story: Trace two circuit branches and close the connection.

phrases.title: Obsidian Guard
phrases.story: Set two strong blocks, rise, and hold a firm finish.

phrases.title: Nebula Drift
phrases.story: Gather a cloud, unfurl it, and let it orbit the body.

phrases.title: Voltage Pop
phrases.story: Send sharp alternating pulses through a held frame.

phrases.title: Portal Step
phrases.story: Frame a doorway, pass a hand through, and close it.

phrases.title: Meteor Strike
phrases.story: Lift, compress, and release two grounded impacts.

phrases.title: Mirage Echo
phrases.story: Repeat a feint on the opposite side, then reveal it.

phrases.title: Quartz Chime
phrases.story: Touch four bright angles before a centered chime.

phrases.title: Gravity Well
phrases.story: Gather inward, rise, settle low, and release the pull.

phrases.title: Signal Relay
phrases.story: Receive a signal, pass it across, and confirm the lock.

phrases.title: Nova Burst
phrases.story: Compress a small core, then open into a broad burst.

phrases.title: Chrome Glide
phrases.story: Slide a polished frame left and right with clean stops.

phrases.title: Vortex Weave
phrases.story: Weave crossing arms through a controlled circular pivot.

phrases.title: Pulsar
phrases.story: Alternate a tight core and a wide synchronized pulse.

phrases.title: Phantom Veil
phrases.story: Draw a veil, peek from both sides, and vanish into rest.

phrases.title: Aurora Ribbon
phrases.story: Send a ribbon across three heights with a soft sweep.

phrases.title: Singularity
phrases.story: Gather orbiting energy, suspend it, and resolve the core.
